## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (for a codec: golden round-trip test, decode then encode equals the original bytes)
- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `refactor:`, `test:`)
- [ ] No new dependency, or its license is stated here: 
- [ ] Clean room: I copied no code, regexes, tables or key lists from closed-source tools or sites
- [ ] `docs/MAP.md` is up to date
- [ ] Screenshot attached (only if the UI changed)
